component.name: WallpaperLayer
component.script:
sub init() m.a = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.b = m.top.createChild("Poster") m.a.id = "wallA" m.b.id = "wallB" for each p in [m.a, m.b] p.width = 1920 p.height = 1080 end for m.b.opacity = 0 m.front = m.a m.a.uri = "pkg:/images/wall/wall_" + m.top.theme + "_home.jpg" m.top.deep = LumenTheme().themes[m.top.theme].deep
m.fade = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.fade.duration = 0.9 m.fade.easeFunction = "inOutCubic" m.fadeIn = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeIn.key = [0, 1] m.fadeIn.keyValue = [0, 1] m.fadeOut = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeOut.key = [0, 1] m.fadeOut.keyValue = [1, 0] end sub
sub onTheme() key = m.top.theme t = LumenTheme().themes[key] if t = invalid or m.front = invalid then return if m.front.isSameNode(m.a) then m.back = m.b else m.back = m.a m.back.observeField("loadStatus", "onLoaded") m.back.uri = "pkg:/images/wall/wall_" + key + "_home.jpg" m.top.deep = t.deep end sub
' Crossfade only once the new painting is decoded, so there's never a flash (spec 8.3). sub onLoaded() if m.back.loadStatus <> "ready" then return m.back.unobserveField("loadStatus") m.fadeIn.fieldToInterp = m.back.id + ".opacity" m.fadeOut.fieldToInterp = m.front.id + ".opacity" m.fade.control = "start" m.front = m.back end sub
